hook: [act:hushed, drawing us in][tune:level]A city from ^Homer. [act:same rhythm][tune:level]Vikings in a land of ^grapes. [act:a little darker][tune:fall]A monster in a ^maze. [act:wonder, widening out]For a long time, experts filed legends like these under ^poetry, or trusted them too ^much. [act:the big question][tune:rise]So which myths came ^true? [act:bright, rolling up sleeves][tune:fall]Let's investigate ^seven of them, one by ^one.

cases.evidence_note: tree rings: wood cut in 1021 CE
cases.t1: [act:storytelling, like a guide]First stop: ^Newfoundland, and turf halls with Norse ^rivets.
cases.t2: [act:curious][tune:rise]Were the sagas right about Vikings sailing ^west, to a land of ^grapes?
cases.t3: [p:0.9][act:explaining, delighted]In {993|nine ninety-three}, a solar storm ^date-stamped that year's ring in every ^tree. [act:the result]Count the rings to the ^bark: this Norse wood was cut in {1021|ten twenty-one}.

cases.t1: [act:storytelling]Next, ^Troy, where diggers found nine cities stacked like a layer ^cake.
cases.t2: [act:the question][tune:rise]Was Homer's Troy a real and ^powerful city?
cases.t3: [act:impressed]One had walls up to five metres ^thick. [act:the payoff]And Hittite archives name a western kingdom, ^Wilusa: in Greek, Wilios, ^Ilion.
cases.t4: [act:the verdict, confident][tune:fall]A real, powerful city: *strong ^evidence*. [act:warm, a small smile][tune:fall]The war, exactly as sung, is still a ^poem.

cases.evidence_note: all dated within the last 2,600 years
cases.t1: [act:storytelling, wonder]Now the ^Amazon: lasers fired through the forest found roads, and thousands of earthen ^platforms.
cases.t2: [act:fair, giving him his due][tune:rise]Graham Hancock asked: was that know-how inherited from a lost Ice Age ^civilisation?
cases.t3: [act:the evidence, clear]But every dated earthwork falls within about the last twenty-six hundred ^years, long after any Ice ^Age.
cases.t4: [act:the verdict][tune:fall]Towns in the Amazon: ^*established*. [act:level][tune:fall]An Ice Age inheritance: *awaiting ^evidence*.

cases.t1: [act:storytelling, playful]Next, ^Knossos, on Crete: hundreds of rooms, easy to get ^lost in.
cases.t3: [act:delighted]Bulls are ^everywhere, in frescoes and stone ^horns. [act:hushed wonder]A clay tablet records@verb honey for the Mistress of the ^Labyrinth.
cases.t4: [act:the verdict, warm][tune:fall]A myth remembering a real palace: ^*plausible*. [act:honest, a gentle limit]But Greeks told it centuries ^later; the chain can't be ^traced.

cases.evidence_note: tree rings: 3 dry years, c. 1198 BCE
cases.t1: [act:grave, storytelling]Around {1200|twelve hundred} BCE, palaces from Greece to Syria fell like ^dominoes.
cases.t2: [act:intrigued]Egypt blamed raiders from the ^sea. [act:the question][tune:rise]Were they the ^cause?
cases.t3: [act:the evidence, measured]They were real: Egypt carved their ^ships. [act:the counterweight]But tree rings record@verb a savage ^drought, and some cities were simply ^abandoned.
cases.t4: [act:balanced][tune:fall]One force inside a bigger collapse: ^*plausible*. [act:fair][tune:rise]The main ^cause? [act:even][tune:fall]A ^*mixed record@noun*.

cases.t1: [act:epic, restrained]Next, ^Britain, after Rome leaves: a war-leader wins a famous battle, at ^Badon.
cases.t3: [act:the evidence]The one writer of the time, ^Gildas, names a hero: not ^Arthur. [p:0.9][act:the gap, a light comparison]Arthur first appears three hundred years later, like a battle from the {1720s|seventeen twenties} naming its hero only ^today.
cases.t4: [act:the verdict, level-headed][tune:fall]A real Arthur: an ^*open question*.

cases.t1: [act:hushed, respectful]Last stop: ^Turin: a linen bearing the faint image of a crucified ^man.
cases.t2: [act:fair, giving them their due][tune:rise]Supporters of an older date ^ask: could it be ^first-century?
cases.t3: [p:0.9][act:explaining, precise]Three laboratories read@past its radiocarbon ^clock independently: {1260|twelve sixty} to {1390|thirteen ninety} ^CE. [act:fair, measured]Critics blamed one ^corner; a {2026|twenty twenty-six} re-test found no ^repair.
cases.t4: [act:the verdict, careful and fair][tune:fall]A first-century date: *ruled ^out*. [act:sincere, gentle, with respect]What it ^means to believers, we never ^rate.

close: [act:stepping back, warm]Sometimes the myth was ^right and the experts were wrong: Troy, Vinland, the Amazon's ^towns.
[act:a small smile]Sometimes the ^reverse, and a bold theory met its ^dates.
[act:simple, the lesson]Either way, the only way to know is to ^dig.
[act:warm, sincere]Legends, it turns out, are worth taking ^seriously, and worth ^checking.
